name: PLSC 3810
title: Fundamentals of Plant Pathology
description: Causal agents, nature and dynamics of plant disease. Pathogen biology, factors influencing disease development, diagnosis of diseases, and principles of plant disease control with emphasis on major diseases of crop, horticultural and turfgrass systems. Formerly offered as SPSS 3810.
requirement_description: BIOL 1108 or 1110; open to juniors or higher.
